title: Python: complete radio operation fit admission
description:
Compose the existing calculator in python/src/lichen/timing/airtime.py with actual encoded frames from python/src/lichen/link/frame.py and scheduler geometry. Admission must fit setup, retuning, CCA, the entire PHY frame, any explicitly reserved turnaround/response and one trailing guard before the protected boundary. SCHC/CoAP responses otherwise need their own opportunities. Application length alone must never determine fit.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: The airtime calculator already exists and is not a missing implementation. Reuse it and retain legacy vectors, using frozen independent expected results rather than copying its output. Keep complete-operation admission distinct from the minimum slot constant, regulatory occupancy and delivery evidence. No experimental narrowband, microfragment or PHY activation, SCHC replacement, or security change belongs here.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.06 through the production fit calculation using independent Semtech arithmetic and interval expectations. Check SF10 100-byte airtime of 1026048 us and 255-byte airtime of 2295808 us; 2346 ms covers only the latter plus the 50 ms guard. Test exact fit, one-unit overrun, insufficient setup slack, control framing, missing response opportunity and no double guard. Extend focused timing tests and python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py; run pytest, ruff and applicable typing.
